content: Isare dúha diya
Isa, Pak Ruhor šoktiye furaiya oiyore Zordanottu firi aišše edde he Pak Ruhor išaraye bošoti sara elehat sairi goijje,
zeṛe hibare sališ din foijjonto šoitane dúha diye, ar he din okkolot maze Isaye hána hono kissu no há, he din okkol šeš oi bade hibattu buk laigge.
Toi Šoitane Isare hodde, "Tui zodi Allar Fut oi, toile ei fattorguware ho ruṭi oizagoi."
Isaye hitare zuwabe hodde,

content.text: "Iyan endilla leka ase: 'Manuš šude ruṭi loi no base.'"

content: Tarfore Šoitane Isare ek usol faharor uwore loigiye edde ek sator butore duniyair hár raijjore dehaiye.
Toi Šoitane Isare hodde, "Ãi tore ei hár odihar edde zak zomok diyum; kiyollahoile in ãre diya oiye, ar ãttu zare issa lage ãi hitare di.
Hetolla tui zodi ãre sojida goros, toile in beggun tor oibo."
Isaye zuwabe hitare diye:

content.text: "Leka ase: 'Tũi tũwar Mabud Allare sojida goro, edde lehar hibare šeba goro.'"

content: Tarfore Šoitane Isare Zeruzalemor uwore loigiye edde dórmogóror tulir uwore tiya goraiyore hodde: "Tui zodi Allar Fut, toile enttu nise zaf mar.
Kiyollahoile kitabot leka ase:

content.text: "'Hibaye hibar firista okkolore tor babute hokum dibo,
tore uddar goribolla.
Hitara tore hatot gori tuli loibo,
zene tor ṭengot fattoror ujaṭ no lage.'"

content: Kintu Isaye hitare zuwab diye,

content.text: "Iyan endilla howa oiye: 'Tũi tũwar Allah Mabudore forikka no goijjo.'"

content: Šoitane hibare hár ḍoilla gori dúha diya šeš oi bade, toi hite olfo ṭaimolla hibar hãsottu dur oigiyegoi.
Isa Nasarator sinagogot
Ruhor šoktit Isa Galilot firigiye edde elehar hár zagat hibar hóbor sorai giyegoi.
Isaye hitarar bout sinagog okkolot šikka diye edde beggune Isare tarif goijje.
Isa Nasarat fara aišše, zeṛe hiba zuwan oil. Dórmor din Isaye nizor rosom mozin sinagogot giye. Heṛe hibaye pak kalam foribolla uṛi tiyaiye.
Tarfore hibar hatot nobi Esaiyar leka kitabwa diya oiye. He rol beraiya kitabwa kuli hibaye he zagagan faiye zeṛe leka ase:

content.text: "Allah Mabudor Ruh ãr uwore ase,
kiyollahoile Allaye ãre ṭik goijje
zene ãi gorib okkolor hãse kušir hóbor tobolig gori.
Hibaye ãre bondi okkolor hãse azadir hota,
anda okkolor hãse nozor danor hota gušona goribolla defeṛaiye.
Zene zara zulum far hitarare ãi rehai gori fari.
edde Mabudor rahamotor bosor elan gori."

content: Tarfore Isaye he rol beraiya kitabware berai hademor hatot diye edde boišše. Muzolišhanar fotti mainšor suk Isar uzu oiye.
Isaye hitarare en hoi šuru goijje,

content.text: "Pak kitabor ei kalam tũwara funone aziya hiyan furon oiye."

content: Henot beggune Isar babute goba diye edde Isar mukottu rahamoti hota funi hitara beggune tajjuf oiye. Hitara hodde, "Iba Yusufor fuwa no?"
Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ãre hameka en boson hoiba: 'Ḍakṭor, age nizore aramgor!' Aro hoiba 'Kofornahum šohorot zen zen gora oiye boli funni hendilla eṛe niz farat o hen gori deha.'"

content: Isaye aro hodde:

content.text: "Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, hono nobire nizor farar mainše no gose.
Ar ãi tũwarare hoir, soiyi oilde nobi Eliyasor ṭaimot zẽtte šaro tin bosor zór noddil edde har deš okkolot raṭ oil, hẽtte Israil dešot beša beši rari mayafuwain okkol aššil.
Kintu Eliyasore hitara honokiyor hãse defeṛa no o, bolke Sidon elehar Šarifot farar ek rari mayafuwar hãse defeṛa oil.
Nobi Elišar ṭaimot Israil dešot bout kurus biyaraimma okkol aššil, kintu hitara honokiyore aram gora no o, bolke Siriya dešor Namanore aram gora oil."

content: Ei hota funi he muzolišhanar manuš beggun guššaye oin oiye.
Ar hitara uṛi Isare he farattu ṭeli niyolai loi za šuru goijje. Hitara ze faharot fara bainde hiyanor haindar uwore loigiye edde Isare nise feli dito saiye.
Kintu Isaye hitarar mazottu ãṛi giyegoi, honokiye Isare sui no fare.
Isaye bod ruhuye faiya manuš bala goijje
Isaye nise Galil elehar Kofornahum šohorot giye edde dórmor din manuš okkolore šikka diya šuru goijje.
Manuš okkole Isar šikkat tajjuf oiye, kiyollahoile hibar kalam kemotawola aššil.
Heṛe sinagogot napak butor ruhuye failde ekzon manuš aššil.
He manušwaye ḍak mari hodde: "Oh, Nasarator Isa, õne loi ãrar loi ki talukkat? Õne ki ãrare binaš goitto aiššo? Ãi zani õne honnuwa, õne Allar he Pak zon!"
Kintu Isaye hibare dõk diyore hodde:

content.text: "Nizam o, ei manušwar butottu niyoli ai."

content: Toi he bod ruhuye manušware mainšor sarme meṛit asari felai raki hitar butottu niyoli giyegoi, manušwar hono hoti no o.
Manuš okkol beggune tajjuf oiyore hitara ekzonore ekzone hodde: "In ki hota! Odihar edde šokti loi napak but okkolore hokum de, ar hitara niyoli aiye!"
Toi ei hóbor he elehar hár mikka sorai giyegoi.
Bade Isa muzolišhanattu niyoli Simonor górot giye. Hẽtte Simonor hori zor biyaram loi beši hošto fat aššil. Hetolla hitara hibare aram goribolla Isar hãse foriyad goijje.
Toi Isaye Simonor horir ḍake tiyai zor biyaramore dõk diye. Ar hibattu zor sari giyegoi edde hibaye hehon uṛi hitaralla hána danar bebosta goijje.
Beil dufedde ṭaimot maze, manušzon okkole har biyaraimma zara ḍoilla boḍoilla biyaram loi hoštofar, hitarare Isar hãse ainne. Isaye hitara fottizonor uwore hat raikke, edde hitarare aram goijje.
Ar beši mainšottu bod ruh niyoli giyegoi, bod ruh okkole guzori hodde, "Tũi Allar Fut!" Kintu Isaye hitarare dõk diye edde hoito no de, kiyollahoile hiba Moside hiyan hitara zainto.
Din zehon oiye Isaye he zagattu zaigoire ekkan nirzon zagat giye. Manuš okkole Isare tuwai tuwai hibar hãse giye. Hitara Isare berai dori taikke zene hiba hitarar hãsottu no zagoi.
Kintu Isaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Aro bout zagat zai ãttu Allar raijjor kušir hóbor tobolig goragoi foribo, kiyollahoile Allaye ãre in goribolla defeṛaiye."

content: Tarfore Isaye Ehudiya elehar sinagog okkolot zai zai kušir hóbor tobolig gorat taikke.
